lede: Miami carries the stronger underlying team rating — +5.5 against +4.3, a 1.3-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Wake Forest +14.6 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Miami winning 83% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is running backs, where Miami leads Wake Forest by 84 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
